case_title: Nitya Nand v. State of U.P. & Anr.
neutral_facts: The accused, along with others, were part of an unlawful assembly with the common object of eliminating the deceased by criminal force. The deceased was assaulted by the other accused persons with weapons such as kanta and knives, resulting in his death. The accused in question fired a shot from a country-made pistol into the air to frighten the witnesses and then fled the scene. The post-mortem report confirmed multiple injuries on the deceased, indicating the assault was homicidal. The prosecution relied on eyewitness accounts and medical evidence to establish the involvement of the accused in the unlawful assembly and the murder.
